title: Relation Between Serum Uric Acid and Metabolic Syndrome in Type 2 DM
brief_summary: This study will be undertaken to evaluate the association of serum uric acid (SUA) level with metabolic risk factors in patients with type 2 diabetes and their relation to eGFR status
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* type 2 diabetic patient

Exclusion Criteria:

1. patients with type 1 diabetes
2. gestational diabetes
3. patients with drug affecting uric acid levels
4. secondary diabetes
study_population: patient will be collected randomly from outpatient clinics of diabetic center of assiut univeristy
